text: The higher-timeframe read I use is the weekly swing (C21, a house rule, not the author's): W and D HH/HL, so the weekly is not broken. D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.09 is a fresh resistance break (C26) and elder_pattern CORRECTION_REENTRY is impulse re-entering (C28). ma100 316.21 under ma200 316.75 is not a test in my deck, which names no 100 or 200 average (C1). W 5.0% under its 20-wk high is room overhead, not a missing signal. I hold SUPPORT, ACT_NOW, trigger trade_above:bar_high (D). I am wrong on a daily close back under structure_shift_ref, or elder_pattern rolling to INTERRUPTED.
